sense: of a series or a show

evidence: Ter. Hec. prol. 31: prīmō āctū placeō (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Our use: classically an act of a play, a part of the show that stands by itself. No reference work has an English–Latin entry for an episode.
Greek ἐπεισόδιον, a part of a tragedy between two choral songs; not in Lewis & Short.

phrases.english: We’ll watch one episode, then bed.

sources: Lewis & Short: actus
